items.description: The agent engineering platform. LangChain is a framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications. It helps you chain together interoperable components and third-party integrations to simplify AI application development.
items.architecture_summary: LangChain provides a modular framework for building LLM applications with chainable components. It supports RAG through document loaders, text splitters, vector stores, retrievers, and LLM integration. The ecosystem includes LangGraph for agent orchestration and LangSmith for observability.
key_modules: langchain: Chains, agents, and retrieval strategies
langgraph: Agent orchestration and workflow management
items.installation_summary: Available via pip/uv: 'uv add langchain'. Supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and vector stores (Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.).
reproducibility_notes: Well-documented API with extensive examples and cookbooks
limitations: Abstraction overhead may introduce complexity for simple use cases
